name: Csögle (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner of two stripes, red at the hoist and blue at the fly, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Csögle (a red shield with a white horse, with a helm, a crest and red and blue mantling) above the name CSÖGLE in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Csögle arms with helm, crest and mantling
